description: Complete CSpell configuration with all dictionaries enabled
comments: This configuration enables ALL available dictionaries for maximum term coverage.
Unlike language-specific configs, this doesn't set up language-specific rules,
but ensures that terms from any ecosystem are recognized.
- Projects that use multiple tech stacks
- Slightly slower performance (more dictionaries to check)
- Some domain-specific jargon accepted across all files
- Terms from one language not being flagged in another
